The '''KiSteer 1284 projectile rifle''' was a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] used during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] was known to carry a KiSteer 1284.

==Description==
The KiSteer 1284 was a long-range rifle favored by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] since its projectiles did not leave a visible trail as with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons. However, the rifle could be configured to produce tracer fire if necessary. Although its penetration power was not great, the rifle's top-mounted optical scope made it highly accurate, and since it contained no powered machinery or minute sensor arrays, it could not be jammed. Also, the 1284 featured a cleaning rod, a recoil-dampening stock and an electromagnetic pulse barrel to shut down tracking devices. The rifle was also fitted with power amplification circuitry to increase its fire rate.

==History==
[[File:KiSteer_1284_projectile_rifle.jpg|thumb|200px|Zam Wesell takes aim with her KiSteer 1284 from atop the [[Trade Federation office tower/Legends|Trade Federation Office Tower]].]]
Zam Wesell began using her KiSteer 1284 on the advice of her associate [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], who believed she needed to augment and diversify her arsenal with a long-range weapon. Zam grew to admire the weapon, which she commonly kept in a secret compartment on the wing of her [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|''Koro-2'' exodrive airspeeder]]. Zam outfitted her rifle with a [[Thermal/Optical-imaging scope]]<ref name="FF73">{{FactFile|73|WES 3-4|Zam Wesell's Weapons}}</ref> that was configured to display targeting information in the same [[Unidentified script (Star Wars '76)|script]] as her [[Electro-goggles/Legends|electro-goggles]].<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref><ref name="Holographic Artist">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/feature/20020716/indexp2.html|text=''Holographic'' Artist: Philip Metschan}}</ref><ref name="Portfolio">{{WebCite|url=http://Principiagraphica.com/portfolio.htm|text=Philip Metschan's portfolio|archivedate=20110715113025}}</ref> Her rifle was also equipped with [[power amplifier circuitry]] to increase the firing rate as well as a [[recoil-damping stock]] to account the increased power.<ref name="FF73" />

Following the second failed assassination attempt on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], Zam used her rifle to destroy [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]] from a distance of twenty meters, in order to dislodge [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Although the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] was blown apart, Kenobi survived the fall as he landed in an [[XJ-6 airspeeder|airspeeder]] driven by his [[padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker]].
